Comment: frame-inspection: pooled (asset, category, span) requests -> frame selection from shot-segmentation's OWN archives (frames.tar.gz @4fps + embeddings.npz; embedding-distance change gate + 6s heartbeat; NO ffmpeg, NO source, NO re-extraction) -> ONE pooled waitForTaskToken submit to bedrock-inference -> salvage-parsed, schema-checked per-category products (credits.json / titles.json / verdicts.json), raw responses joined by POINTER only. conversation-analysis's five-state template with the selection step widened to a Map. Design record: README.md §5-§10. Readability copy of the template's inline DefinitionString; edit BOTH, the build fails on drift.

Validate and plan.Comment: Everything that can refuse refuses HERE, before any inference dollar: every asset's shot-segmentation run validated (window manifests + embeddings.npz + frames tarballs present), auto-trigger spans derived per request (nondiegetic shot_kind runs bridged over <=5s black for credits-read; unreadable_text_present clusters OUTSIDE blocks for title-read) or explicit spans validated (claim-verify REQUIRES explicit spans, each carrying its question), every category bound in prompt-registry, model chain IMAGE-capable. Emits the selection-unit list bounded by IMAGES per unit (<=18, the record size — a 120s credit tail is many units, a 3s super is one; README.md §10). Persists _plan/plan.json; states pass URIs, never bodies.

Select frames.Comment: One iteration per selection-unit batch. Each iteration: fetch the unit's window jsons + embeddings.npz slices, select frames by embedding-distance change gate OR >=6s heartbeat (the heartbeat is load-bearing — a slow scroll changes too little frame-to-frame and a change-only gate collapsed mitj404's cast roll to nothing, measured 2026-08-29), extract ONLY the chosen JPEGs from _frames.tar.gz, render the converse-shaped record through the copied prompt_render, checkpoint as _records/unit_NNNN.json. record_id = {asset_idx}:{category}:{span_idx}:{chunk} — the demux key. LambdaResourceTimeoutException retries RESUME (existing side objects are skipped), never restart.

Stage records.Comment: Concatenate the unit checkpoints in plan order into ONE pooled records.jsonl — STREAMED via S3 multipart, never held whole (images inline). Refuses on a missing checkpoint or a record over the image budget. The pooling is the point (README.md §8): one batch job across every request of every asset in the call.

Submit and wait.Comment: The template's shape verbatim: ONE held state, NO polling. The handler invokes bedrock-inference's gateway inline (records_s3uri + callback_task_token + idempotency_token = THIS run's uuid) and writes the history pointer from the TRUE submit response. NO Catch: a timeout FAILS the execution, and a REDRIVE of this state resubmits, absorbs, and is completed synchronously — redrive IS the reconcile. use_batch defaults TRUE (catalog sweeps); claim-verify inside a waiting AD run passes use_batch=false.

Collect and finalize.Comment: Salvage-parse response.jsonl per record (copied parse_partial_output ladder: strict first, counted recovery tiers), schema-check per category (claim-verify's verdict validated against its enum — an out-of-enum answer is a parse failure), demux by record_id into per-asset per-category products ({run}/{asset_idx}/credits.json | titles.json | verdicts.json), each carrying gaps[] for spans whose read did not survive — honest gap, reasoned, never fabricated. Partial success IS success; the semantic retry is the caller's fresh idempotency_token. Raw responses are NEVER copied: the manifest's inference_runs[] points at the bedrock run's own prefix.

Usage tracking.Comment: Aggregates the bedrock run's summaries with the cost_is_complete discipline; success-path only, never raises.
